snippet.title: Ayna: Shattered Truth — Reveal Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1742390?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=web

Become water. Be shapeless, be formless, be fluid. All living things are from water and you can transform water into what it needs to be. Dive into this Kyrgyz fairytale and take on the journey of finding your place in this Metroidvania fantasy world.

Get out our game dev tool Nur: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nur-empowering-creativity/id1487456336
